llm_input:
Synopsis:
If Marrow of Mercy is thrown in the burning Circle of Pearls while Vanra is still alive inside the hag, the hag will vomit her out in this dialogue

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_VomitsOutVanra_Hag.json: Auntie Ethel is the hag who recently shed her human disguise and had been taunting the party that she “ate” Lora’s missing child, Vanra, claiming the girl sat in her belly as part of a cruel boast. In this branch the player has thrown the Marrow of Mercy into a burning Circle of Pearls while Vanra is still alive inside Ethel, provoking the hag to gag, retch, and begin vomiting. Off‑screen this follows the reveal/confrontation with the hag and her theatrical cruelty and demands; the immediate result is that Vanra will be expelled — badly traumatized and largely catatonic — and Lora (her mother) is likely nearby and distraught. The player line is a blunt command to force Ethel to “cough her up.”
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_VanraSaved.json: Off‑screen the player has already recovered Vanra from a hag—either she was vomited out or physically carved free—and returned the child to her mother, Lora, at their home/inn (the Blushing Mermaid). Vanra is physically present but severely traumatized and largely catatonic, only able to mumble “Mummy” with glazed eyes. Lora is distraught, wracked with guilt, and trying to comfort her while the player (and possibly companions) stand nearby after confronting the hag or her disguise. That state explains Vanra’s broken, repetitive lines and why player replies swing between soft reassurance and impatient frustration.
- LOW_BlushingMermaid_SavingVanra.json: The player has just fought and knocked Auntie Ethel unconscious after she shed a human disguise and revealed herself as a hag. Ethel had bragged that she swallowed Lora’s missing child, Vanra, and is now physically distended with the child inside. In this scene the immediate option is to cut Ethel open to try to free and save Vanra; companions who confronted Ethel earlier may be present and react. Earlier choices (whether you killed or spared Lora, or how you dealt with Ethel’s bargains and taunts) affect tone and companions’ responses but not the basic fact that Vanra is inside the hag.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_DisguisedJatloInstaDied.json: Dialog between survivors gathered around a dead hag spy, Jatlo. Happens when the hag is killed before players have triggered combat with the spy.Mayrina and Mask of Regret are optional speakers.
- HAG_HagLair_HagBegsForMercy.json: The hag is on the brink of defeated. She's stoppped the fight to try and plead for her life by offering the player the thing she does best - a deal. If Mayrina is present she asks offers you a powerful gift in exchange for her life (she will also take Mayrina with her) or the hag can bargain for Mayrina's life but lose out on the powerful gift. It is a tense and heightened situation.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Auntie Ethel: What did you - hurk. Stay down, Vanra  - URGH. || [context] CinematicNodeContext: Gagging and wretching - trying to stop herself from puking. Hands over mouth at end of line.NodeContext: Gagging and wretching - trying to stop herself from puking. Hands over mouth at end of line. (node 1)
- Player: That's it - cough her up, hag. (node 8)
